Question: Is it permissible to keep Cats as pets at home? If not please give reason? Answer ID: 20361 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 291/B=49/tb=1431) Yes, you can have cats as pets, it is ok. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
